notes: Only the two wild-type RNA-seq samples of a 3C-seq series are candidates. Title says 'stationary phase 30°C (30h)'; the phase word is used (stationary, stated) although 30 h would by itself give late_stationary. GSM2870441's extract protocol field only describes 3C-seq, but its title, library_strategy RNA-Seq and molecule total RNA mark it as the RNA-seq replicate, so it is labelled total_rnaseq like GSM2870440. Culture mode/aeration not described. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655 wt -> wild_type.
